cross_atom_consistency_findings.issue: Table 1 versus Results-text denominator discrepancy for on-treatment liver tests
cross_atom_consistency_findings.details: Table 1 reports normal ALT/AST/total bilirubin in n=9; the Results text states liver tests were available in 8 of 10. Both assertions were retained as separately anchored atoms rather than silently harmonized.

extraction_limitations: Only the primary ciag422.pdf article was supplied; no correction or supplementary material was specified.
Retrospective real-world case series with incomplete follow-up and no comparator.
The source contains an internal denominator discrepancy for on-treatment liver laboratory availability (Table 1 n=9 vs Results text n=8).
